cross_source_confirmation.finding: The same model-download and boot-readiness logic is present at the frozen Project-Frankenstein head.

findings.evidence: download-models.sh skips any existing destination solely on file existence; new files are wget-downloaded to .tmp then mv'd into place. No expected size, digest or signature check is performed.
findings.required_contract: Container bootstrap must consume the same content-addressed VerifiedArtifact registry as updater/runtime repair. Existing files must be verified, not trusted because present.

findings.evidence: The Qwen source URL points to bartowski/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUF and file Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf, while the destination path is Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-abliterated.Q4_K_M.gguf.
findings.effect: The local filename can assert an 'abliterated' model identity that is not supported by the configured download source/path, contaminating experiment/runtime provenance.
findings.required_contract: Model identity is manifest metadata bound to digest, source revision and tokenizer/config identity; filenames are display labels only.

findings.evidence: wait_for_port returns failure after timeout but explicitly says continuing anyway; entrypoint is set -uo pipefail rather than -e, so sequential readiness calls do not abort boot. A running banner is printed afterward.
findings.effect: Boot can reach a nominal running state despite mandatory LLM/core readiness failure, matching the historical FRANK boot-order/state-fragility concern.
findings.required_contract: Boot is an explicit dependency DAG/state machine. Mandatory readiness failures block downstream activation and prevent RUNNING status; optional services are separately classified.

findings.evidence: The final supervisor loop removes exited children and only exits the container when zero child processes remain. It does not distinguish/restart mandatory critical services despite the comment mentioning critical-service death.
findings.effect: Core/router/model services can die while the container remains alive and other components continue against a partially collapsed system.
findings.required_contract: Every service has typed criticality/dependencies/restart policy. Loss of a mandatory node transitions the organism out of healthy/runnable state and triggers bounded recovery or fail-closed shutdown.

harness: Acceptance must test cold boot with missing/corrupt/wrong-but-existing models, delayed mandatory services and mid-run critical child death.
RUNNING is a derived invariant state, not a startup print statement.
claycode: ModelArtifact and ServiceReadiness must be typed values with digest/dependency semantics.
claygraph: Represent boot as dependency edges and readiness transitions so startup order is reproducible and inspectable.
unifieddb: Persist boot epoch, artifact manifest and readiness transition log for crash/replay comparison.
frank: Identity statements about the active model must come from verified runtime artifact metadata, never inferred from a filename.
gwt: Broadcast degraded/not-ready states when mandatory substrate is unavailable; no false global ignition.
clay: One-module FRANK must retain explicit internal boot/health gates even after process/module boundaries dissolve.
